summary: Iterator that walks a contiguous array of void function pointers starting at a1 and invokes every non-null entry, stopping when the pointer address reaches the limit a2. Calls all non-null callbacks; called by sub_589C77 and sub_589CC6.

operations.description: Iterate function-pointer slots from a1 while (unsigned int)a1 < a2.
Invoke the current entry only when *a1 is non-null.
Indirect call through the current function pointer: (*a1)().
Advance a1 by one function-pointer slot each iteration.

unresolved: a2 is typed unsigned int but is compared against the pointer address cast to unsigned int, so it acts as the end address of the callback array, not a count.
field:this:0x00000000 is a spurious template-generated field; the raw source is a __cdecl helper with two pointer/int parameters and no `this`.
